intent: A compact A/B or A/B/n experiment: status in words, the traffic split and metric per variant, a confidence note and one decision (Ship winner, Stop, Extend, Start). Ship and Stop confirm with a kit AlertDialog.
useWhen: show a running or finished experiment in a product or growth view
let someone ship the winner or stop a test with a confirmation
show a draft A/B/n split before it starts
doNotUseWhen: a feature flag on or off — Switch
a recommendation to act on — InsightCard

variants.note: { id, label, traffic, value?, isWinner?, isLeading? }[]; lettered A, B, C…

onShip.note: (variantId) => void, after the AlertDialog. The one solid primary.

requirements: status, Winner and Leading are words in a kit Badge, not colour alone
variants are a list; each says "Variant B:" to screen readers; a missing value says "no data yet"
Ship and Stop open a kit AlertDialog; Cancel returns focus to the button that opened it
aria-busy while loading; the error is role=alert

doNot: Do not invent a local ABTestCard or VariantList
Do not ship or stop without the AlertDialog
Do not mark the winner by colour alone
snippet: <ExperimentCard name="Checkout button copy" metricLabel="Conversion rate" status="running" dates="Started 02 Nov · ends 16 Nov" variants={variants} confidenceNote="84% confidence · needs ~4 more days for 95%." onStop={stop} onView={view} />
